name: sst-ai-skills
description: Private SST AI Claude Code plugin marketplace: shared (common) and service-specific skills for SCM repositories.

plugins.name: backend-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for all SCM backend services (BFF and microservices): convention review, framework catalog, BFF and microservice scaffolding.

plugins.name: frontend-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for SCM Vue web frontends built on sst-fw-web: screen scaffolding, Vue and API client conventions, convention review.

plugins.name: mobile-common
plugins.description: Shared commands for SCM Flutter repositories (app, sst-fw-mobile, widgetbook).

plugins.name: fw-be-common
plugins.description: Shared skills for SST backend framework repositories (sst-fw-be-*).

plugins.name: cm-be-bff-web
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-bff-web: JasperReports report and external integration scaffolding.

plugins.name: cm-be-spec
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-spec: TypeSpec BFF and OpenAPI gRPC contract scaffolding.

plugins.name: cm-be-ms-log
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-ms-log: log search/ingest feature scaffolding and AWS Athena client guidance.

plugins.name: cm-be-ms-dailyinv
plugins.description: Skills specific to cm-be-ms-dailyinv: dual-datasource (PostgreSQL + ClickHouse) feature scaffolding.

plugins.name: sst-fw-be-core
plugins.description: Skills specific to sst-fw-be-core: validation constraint scaffolding and extension utility guidance.
